Bind every native pass and attempt, validate the actual SAT models, check LRAT for every UNSAT in fresh processes, and withhold assurance for missing, duplicated, swapped and transplanted evidence. Measure wall time, generation, checking and retained size. The runner claimed 20261124-033703-certify-ordinary-native-verdicts-and-rep while its shared source revision was being repaired; its exported tree lacked the verifier module. This repeat pins the complete source revision.

steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PYTHON'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
sys.path.insert(0, "lib/python")
import jvmcontract_lrat as lrat

read = lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text())
task = "first-8-release"
example, = Path("examples").glob("336-*")
requests = (example / "receipts" / task / "executions").glob("*/lrat-request.json")
source, = (p for p in requests if read(p.parent / "attempt.json")["job"] == os.environ["VERIFY_JOB_ID"])
request = read(source)
journal = read(source.parent / "attempt.json")
checker = read(source.parent / "checker.json")
result = example / journal["receipt"]
conclusion = read(result)["conclusion"]
assert request["run"] == journal["id"] == conclusion["attempt"]
assert request["claim"]["key"] == read(result)["claim"]["target"]["claimKey"]
assert request["checker"]["classpath"] == journal["checker"]["classpath"]
assert conclusion["status"] == "established" and not conclusion["vacuous"]
anchor = {"status": conclusion["status"], "execution": journal["id"], "conclusion": conclusion,
          "receiptSha256": lrat.digest(result.read_bytes()), "jvmReplay": []}
native, = (Path(os.environ["VERIFY_WORKDIR"]) / ".build-py").glob(
    f"*/targets/336/{task}/{journal['id']}/verifier")
runs = [run for resultset in checker["outcomes"] for run in resultset["search"]["runs"]]
boundary, streams = lrat.capture(request, anchor, native, native / "solver-traces", runs)
root = Path("verification/trusted-kernel-recovery/lrat")
out = root / "independent-guava"
out.mkdir()
(out / "request.json").write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
lrat.save(out / "boundary.json", boundary)
with tarfile.open(out / "native-origin.tar.gz", "w:gz") as arc:
    for p in [source, source.parent / "attempt.json", source.parent / "checker.json", result]:
        arc.add(p, arcname="original/" + p.name)
    for p in [*streams, *native.rglob("bmc.log")]:
        arc.add(p, arcname="verifier/" + p.relative_to(native).as_posix())
# Only now read the issuer's evidence. Neither expected input was loaded from the proof bundle or its sidecars.
check = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", lrat.__file__, "--check", str(out / "request.json"),
                        str(out / "boundary.json"), str(root / task / "evidence.zip")],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
verdict = json.loads(check.stdout)
assert verdict["answers"] == {"sat": 18, "unsat": 8}
lrat.save(out / "recheck.json", verdict)
print("Native journal and both actual call boundaries independently rechecked 18 SAT models and 8 LRAT proofs.")
PYTHON
